Who We Are

Welcome to Realty and Commercial Cleaning Agency LLC, your trusted partner in professional cleaning services. With a commitment to excellence and a passion for cleanliness, we have been serving residential and commercial clients with top-notch cleaning solutions.

At Realty and Commercial Cleaning Agency LLC, we understand the importance of a clean and healthy environment. Whether it’s a residential property that needs a thorough cleaning or a commercial space that requires regular upkeep, our team is dedicated to delivering exceptional results.

Just a-little word from her employees, here is what they had to say about her:

Dedication to her profession is simply unmatched. She always strives not only to be kind and courteous to her clients, Kristy always ensures a good environment for her employees. Safety is her number one moto, and we all love her for it. She always makes me feel I am valued and I truly enjoy working for her company!- Paige

I love being able to work for Kristy , it truly is a great company to meet new clients and it has opened up the doors for others to help start the process of a clean organized life/business with an amazing company! I’m so thankful for Kristy and her team allowing me to be a part of the growth in Realty and Commercial Cleaning Agency. – Lacey

[/dica_divi_carouselitem][dica_divi_carouselitem title=”Leah” field_enable_content_limit=”off” button_url_new_window=”1″ image=”https://rcca.cleaning/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Untitled-design-2024-03-04T133947.730.png” image_padding=”||25px||false|false” _builder_version=”4.27.5″ _module_preset=”default” header_font=”|600|||||||” header_text_align=”center” header_text_color=”#FFFFFF” header_font_size=”40px” body_text_color=”#FFFFFF” body_font_size=”16px” body_line_height=”1.8em” global_colors_info=”{}”]

Leah has been with our company since the red carpet was rolled out.  She is completely dedicated to serve Realty and Commercial Cleaning Agency at all cost. There has never been a request made that she has not received and handled with love and dedication. She has extensive field training and passes all expectations of what is truly needed to get all tasks presented done with perfection. This young lady is TRULY what makes Realty and Commercial Cleaning Agency Shine the absolute Brightest among all of our beautiful community competitors in the wonderful cleaning industry!!!

[/dica_divi_carouselitem][dica_divi_carouselitem title=”Paige” button_url_new_window=”1″ image=”https://rcca.cleaning/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/2-1.png” image_padding=”||25px||false|false” _builder_version=”4.27.5″ _module_preset=”default” header_font=”|600|||||||” header_text_align=”center” header_text_color=”#FFFFFF” header_font_size=”40px” body_text_color=”#FFFFFF” body_font_size=”16px” body_line_height=”1.8em” global_colors_info=”{}”]

This young lady came to our company with such a dedicated oversight.  Something I don’t think I’ve ever seen , her manners are truly contagious and her ability to perform janitorial services are unmatched. She is selfless and always puts others needs before her own. She even taught us how to properly tie a trash bag in the Janitorial World !:) LOL.  She is dedicated , organized, and her janitorial skills are outstanding!!!

[/dica_divi_carouselitem][dica_divi_carouselitem title=”Janna” field_enable_content_limit=”on” field_limit_content_length=”500″ button_url_new_window=”1″ image=”https://rcca.cleaning/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/1.png” image_padding=”||25px||false|false” _builder_version=”4.27.5″ _module_preset=”default” header_font=”|600|||||||” header_text_align=”center” header_text_color=”#FFFFFF” header_font_size=”40px” body_text_color=”#FFFFFF” body_font_size=”16px” body_line_height=”1.8em” global_colors_info=”{}”]

Meet Janna Smith 

Janna is, without question, the most reliable person I have ever met.

Janna does it all — from paperwork and compliance research to deep microfiber cleaning, office organization, and handling any gadget a screwdriver (or power tool) can match up with. She does not take “no” for an answer when there is a solution to be found, and she goes above and beyond in everything she touches.

Without being asked, Janna fixes other employees’ cleaning caddies daily. If there’s a law, she Googles it, understands it, and helps me apply it correctly. She has helped me write our terms and conditions, implement rules I never even thought of, and research solutions to problems I didn’t even know existed. Janna is a mastermind. If it’s a lock with no key — she will figure out how to make one. She is far more than just a cleaner. She is a tool in our companies caddy that I truly could not go without.

Honestly… Janna is a name-brand Milwaukee tool herself. (Our companies favorite tool brand) lol. Thank you, Janna, for your dedication, your intelligence, your grit, and your relentless commitment to excellence. Our company is stronger because of you. 

[/dica_divi_carouselitem][dica_divi_carouselitem title=”Kelsey” field_enable_content_limit=”on” field_limit_content_length=”500″ button_url_new_window=”1″ image=”https://rcca.cleaning/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/2.png” image_padding=”||25px||false|false” _builder_version=”4.27.5″ _module_preset=”default” header_font=”|600|||||||” header_text_align=”center” header_text_color=”#FFFFFF” header_font_size=”40px” body_text_color=”#FFFFFF” body_font_size=”16px” body_line_height=”1.8em” hover_enabled=”0″ global_colors_info=”{}” sticky_enabled=”0″]

Meet Kelsey , one of the most positive, dependable, and caring people I have ever had the privilege of working with.

Kelsey brings excellence, kindness, and heart into every space she serves. She is detailed, fast, eager to learn, and always willing to step in — early mornings, late evenings, holidays… she never hesitates.

One moment that truly touched me was when an elderly client asked for prayer, while our team was there actively cleaning ….without prompting, Kelsey joined in with us and prayed with us out loud. That kind of compassion cannot be taught — it comes from who you are.

Since joining our company, Kelsey has taken a tremendous workload off my shoulders as an owner, and for that I am beyond grateful.

Thank you, Kelsey, for your dedication, your heart for others, and the pride you take in your work. We are blessed to have you.

[/dica_divi_carouselitem][dica_divi_carouselitem title=”Lacey” button_url_new_window=”1″ image=”https://rcca.cleaning/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/4-1.png” image_padding=”||25px||false|false” _builder_version=”4.27.5″ _module_preset=”default” header_font=”|600|||||||” header_text_align=”center” header_text_color=”#FFFFFF” header_font_size=”40px” body_text_color=”#FFFFFF” body_font_size=”16px” body_line_height=”1.8em” global_colors_info=”{}”]

Lacey is an awesome team player  and has also been with Realty and Commercial Cleaning Agency since day 1. She brings beautiful vibrancy to any room she walks in Her smile is contagious and she is will not leave until your expectations are met !!! She also holds a great passion to organize your life. This passion is unmatched in our company and we all are truly blessed to have her be a part of our team. Our Company would not be complete without her !!!!!

[/dica_divi_carouselitem][/dica_divi_carousel][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]
